type Cell = { label: string; hits?: number[] } | null;

function describe(grid: Cell[][], row: number): string[] {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  if (grid[row] === undefined) return lines;
  for (let col = 0; col < grid[row].length; col++) lines.push(`(${row},${col}) ${label(grid[row], col)}`);
  return lines;
}

function label(cells: Cell[], col: number): string {
  if (cells[col] === null) return "empty";
  return cells[col].label;
}

function record(cells: Cell[], index: number, hit: number): void {
  if (cells[index] === null) return;
  if (!cells[index].hits) cells[index].hits = [];
  cells[index].hits.push(hit);
}

function countWords(words: string[]): Record<string, number> {
  const counts: Record<string, number | undefined> = {};
  const result: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const word of words) {
    if (counts[word] === undefined) counts[word] = 0;
    counts[word] += 1;
    result[word] = counts[word];
  }
  return result;
}

const grid: Cell[][] = [
  [{ label: "a" }, null, { label: "c" }],
  [null, { label: "e" }],
];
for (const line of describe(grid, 0)) console.log(line);
console.log(describe(grid, 5).length);
record(grid[1], 1, 7);
record(grid[1], 1, 9);
record(grid[1], 0, 1);
console.log(JSON.stringify(grid[1]));
console.log(JSON.stringify(countWords(["x", "y", "x"])));
